column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Oppressions” is rendered “acts of oppression,” and NASB adds “I saw … that.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Who has not yet been” is rendered “who has never existed.”
“It is envy of a man from his neighbor” is rendered “is the result of rivalry between a man and his neighbor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Eating his own flesh” is rendered “consumes his own flesh.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A handful of quietness” is rendered “One hand full of rest,” and “two hands” as “two fists.”
“One, and there was not a second” is rendered “a certain man without a dependent,” and NASB adds “he never asked” before the question.
Close to the Hebrew; “A good reward” is rendered “a good return.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “together” and “alone.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The threefold thread” is rendered “A cord of three strands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A youth” is rendered “lad,” and “to be warned” as “to receive instruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The house of the prisoners” is rendered “prison.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “throng to the side of,” and “who will arise in his place” is rendered “who replaces him.”
